play_count = 4000000
length_seconds = 200
rating = 4.8
top_song = "Flowers"

# Register functions
def item_total(price, quantity):
    return price * quantity

def add_shipping(amount):
    return amount + 5

# ENDS: a return statement ends the function right away so any lines after it inside the function never run
def make_tag(first, last):
    return first[0] + last

def show_price(p):
    print(p)

def apply_coupon(amount, coupon):
    return amount - coupon

def tax(amount):
    return amount * 10 / 100

# The register
shirts = item_total(12, 3)
print("Shirts:", shirts)
grand = item_total(5, 4) + item_total(2, 10)
print("Grand total:", grand)
print("Order total:", add_shipping(item_total(10, 10)))
print("Tag:", make_tag("Sam", "Rivera"))
r = show_price(9)
print("Result:", r)
# NONE: a function with no return statement hands back None because it only printed and gave nothing back
final = apply_coupon(grand, 5)
print("After coupon:", final)
print("Gift:", apply_coupon(item_total(20, 2), 10))
print("Tax only:", tax(grand))
print("With tax:", grand + tax(grand))
